metrics.construct_text:
NAME: MomentumVolumeRank  
DESC: Rank of stocks with positive short-term momentum and increasing volume.  
EXPR: RANK(TS_PCTCHANGE($return, 5) * TS_PCTCHANGE($volume, 5))  

NAME: VolumeMomentumZscore  
DESC: Z-score of the product of momentum and volume change over 5 days.  
EXPR: ZSCORE(TS_PCTCHANGE($return, 5) * TS_PCTCHANGE($volume, 5), 5)  

NAME: MomentumVolumeCorrelation  
DESC: Correlation between momentum and volume over the past 10 days.  
EXPR: TS_CORR(TS_PCTCHANGE($return, 5), TS_PCTCHANGE($volume, 5), 10)
